# devin_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the repositories connected to an organization, e.g. to look up the repository_path used by devin_repository_indexing and devin_blueprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devin_repositories" "acme" {
  org_id      = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  filter_name = "acme/"
}

# Index every matching repository.
resource "devin_repository_indexing" "acme" {
  for_each        = toset([for r in data.devin_repositories.acme.repositories : r.repository_path])
  org_id          = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  repository_path = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID.

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Only return repositories whose path contains this string (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) Connected repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `git_connection_host` (String) Git host of that connection (e.g. github.com).
- `git_connection_id` (String) Git connection the repository comes from.
- `indexing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether indexing is enabled for the repository.
- `last_updated_at` (Number) Last update time reported by the git provider (Unix seconds).
- `provider_repository_id` (String) Repository ID at the git provider.
- `repo_description` (String) Repository description from the git provider.
- `repo_language` (String) Primary language reported by the git provider.
- `repo_name` (String) Repository name.
- `repo_path` (String) Repository path at the git provider, without the host (e.g. acme/web).
- `repository_path` (String) Devin's identifier for the repository, the value devin_repository_indexing and devin_blueprint take: the path for github.com (e.g. acme/web), prefixed with the host for other git hosts (e.g. gitlab.example.com/acme/web), or a perforce:// URI for Perforce depots.
